headSHASemantics: This is the exact keyboard traversal and VoiceOver implementation commit. The following documentation-only evidence commit does not change production or test code.
scope: A bounded typed JSON Canvas decoder, a closed native built-in registration, a local read-only SwiftUI surface with pan, zoom, selection, deterministic keyboard traversal, individual VoiceOver node semantics, corrected capability metadata, and focused validation boundary tests.

success: The planner selects JSON Canvas only through the closed built-in descriptor map.
The decoder preserves input order and makes deterministic outline and render projections.
The native state clamps pan and zoom, selects nodes by canvas point or outline entry, and traverses the deterministic document outline.
The native view exposes selectable individual canvas-node and outline-entry semantics, with matching deterministic keyboard traversal and VoiceOver order.
error: Unavailable, malformed, oversized, unsupported, unknown-field, excessive-node, excessive-edge, duplicate-identifier, invalid-geometry, oversized-text, and unknown-edge-endpoint input fails closed.
The built-in factory returns nil for unavailable or malformed input so the existing host keeps Source fallback.
boundary: The decoder checks the 256 KiB input bound before JSON decoding.
The decoder bounds nodes, edges, identifiers, text, coordinates, zoom, and translation.
The viewport clamps translation at both bounds and ignores non-finite zoom factors.
The decoder accepts only text nodes and only modeled fields. It retains no URL or action data.
coverage.cancellation: Not applicable. The decoder and native state have no task, session, or asynchronous operation.
coverage.teardown: Not applicable. The focused decoder and state tests retain no resources.

bidirectionalResolution.command: inventory=plans/dynamic-renderers-phase6-json-canvas-test-inventory.json && jq -e '(.productionPaths | length > 0) and (.testPaths | length > 0) and all(.productionPaths[]; ((.path | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.symbols | type == "array" and length > 0) and (.tests | type == "array" and length > 0))) and all(.testPaths[]; type == "string" and length > 0)' "$inventory" >/dev/null && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory production path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.productionPaths[].path' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r listedPath; do test -f "$listedPath" || { echo "inventory test path is missing: $listedPath" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r testName; do functionName=${testName##*.}; matches=$(rg -l -F "func ${functionName}(" $(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$matches" -eq 1 || { echo "inventory test did not resolve exactly once: $testName" >&2; exit 1; }; done < <(jq -r '[.productionPaths[].tests[]] | unique[]' "$inventory")

excluded: Phase 5 host, WebView session, bridge, navigation, CSP, safe-mode, and trusted-activation contracts
JSON Canvas links, file and wiki actions, appearance, and Reduce Motion follow-up work
package installation, management, rollback, removal, and Phase 7 work
honestCoverageLimits: The native renderer supports text nodes and node-to-node edges only. It does not support JSON Canvas file, link, or group nodes.

The descriptor sets supportsVoiceOver and supportsKeyboardNavigation to true. The focused pure-state test proves deterministic selection order, while source review verifies the individual SwiftUI node and outline semantics.
The focused tests validate the model and state. They do not host a SwiftUI window, exercise AppKit focus routing or VoiceOver output, or make a screenshot or golden-image assertion.
DocumentationContractTests passed after b75430935e5cb7bf8871c3aa8ae2c6cd6c23583f refreshed the Phase 5 inventory evidence.
The bounded matcher can still select a document whose full decode fails. In that case the factory returns nil and the existing host keeps Source fallback.
